source_text:
15.4 Οὐ μὴ συναγάγω τὰς συναγωγὰς αὐτῶν ἐξ
αἱμάτων, οὐδὲ μὴ μνησθῶ τῶν ὀνο μάτων αὐτῶν διὰ χειλέων μου. Συνάγων, φησὶ,
συναγωγὰς ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν, οὐ δι' αἱμάτων αὐτὰ συνάξω, οὐδὲ παρασ κευάσω διὰ τῆς
νομικῆς μοι προέρχεσθαι λατρείας, δι' αἰνέσεως δὲ μᾶλλον καὶ τῆς ἀναιμάκτου
θυσίας· πάλαι μὲν, φησὶν, ἐπ' ἀ ξίαν τῶν πράξεων ἐπήγοντο προσηγορίας,
εἰδωλολάτραι, πολύθεοι ὀνομαζόμενοι· νῦν δὲ οὐκέτι μνησθήσομαι τῶν ὀνομάτων
ἐκεί νων· εὐσεβεῖς αὐτοὺς καὶ ἁγίους, κλητούς τε καὶ ἐκλεκτοὺς ὀνομάζων.
pass_a_gloss: Not not I-will-gather the assemblies of-them out-of bloods, nor not I-will-remember the names of-them through lips of-me. Gathering, he-says, assemblies out-of the nations, not through bloods them I-will-gather, nor I-will-prepare through the legal to-me to-come-forward worship, through praise but rather and the bloodless sacrifice; formerly on-the-one-hand, he-says, upon worth of-the deeds they-were-brought appellations, idolaters, polytheists being-named; now but no-longer I-will-remember the names of-those; pious them and holy, called both and elect naming.
pass_b_english: “I will not gather their assemblies from bloods, nor will I remember their names through my lips” (Psalm 15:4).

Gathering, he says, assemblies from the nations, I will not gather them through bloods, nor will I prepare them to come forward to me through the legal worship, but rather through praise and the bloodless sacrifice.

Formerly, he says, they were brought to appellations according to the worth of their deeds, being named idolaters, polytheists; but now I will no longer remember those names, calling them pious and holy, called and elect.

choices.english: I will not gather them through bloods
choices.why: The nations are not gathered by the blood of legal victims. Not ‘from blood relatives’.
rejected: I will not gather them from blood relatives

choices.term: διὰ τῆς νομικῆς μοι προέρχεσθαι λατρείας
choices.english: to come forward to me through the legal worship
choices.why: νομική λατρεία is the Mosaic cult. Not ‘legal service’ as civic law.

choices.term: δι’ αἰνέσεως δὲ μᾶλλον καὶ τῆς ἀναιμάκτου θυσίας
choices.english: but rather through praise and the bloodless sacrifice
choices.why: Praise and the bloodless sacrifice replace bloods. Not ‘through bloodless praise only’.
rejected: through praise of a bloodless victim only

choices.term: ἐπ’ ἀξίαν τῶν πράξεων ἐπήγοντο προσηγορίας
choices.english: they were brought to appellations according to the worth of their deeds
choices.why: Former names matched their idolatry. OCR ἀ ξίαν. Not ‘they were led by worthy deeds’.
rejected: they were led by worthy deeds

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
